description: This PHP class defines the LeavePeriodHistory entity for the OrangeHRM system, including properties for leave period start month, start day, creation date, and associated getter/setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes a decorator trait.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the history of leave periods, with properties for start month, start day, creation date, and ORM configuration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave period history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave period history record.

methods.name: getStartMonth
methods.description: Returns the start month of the leave period.

methods.name: setStartMonth
methods.description: Sets the start month of the leave period.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Returns the start day of the leave period.

methods.name: setStartDay
methods.description: Sets the start day of the leave period.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the leave period record.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the leave period record.
